steps.title: Your DM
body: Your DM with {name} is where you ask for things for yourself. What you ask for yourself (research, mail, calendar) comes back here unless you ask to share it.
Every step below works the same way: ask {name}, and it does the work with you. Start here:
steps.paste: What can you do for me today?
steps.locate: {name} is under Your agents at the top of the sidebar.

steps.title: Rooms
body: You, your teammates and all of your agents meet in one room. Everyone brings their own agents, and each agent works for its owner.
Ask {name} to make one for you:

screenshot.alt: The + menu at the top of the room list
The new room dialog, with your agent under AI stands you own

steps.paste: Make me a room for a project. Ask me its name and who should be in it, create it, and invite yourself.
steps.locate: Press + at the top of the room list and choose New room. To add an agent later, open the room menu (⋮) and choose Invite.

steps.title: Commons
body: Each room's shared Docs, HTML pages, PDFs, Figma files, whiteboards, sheets and databases, which everyone in the room can open and edit.
In a room, ask {name}:

screenshot.alt: The Commons button at the right of the room header
Commons: Doc, Whiteboard, HTML, PDF, Figma, Sheet and Database

steps.paste: Draft a page with me in this room's Commons. Ask me what it is for, then write the first version and send me the link.
steps.locate: The Commons button at the right of the room header.

steps.title: Your workers
body: A worker is another agent of yours, with its own name and identity, that takes work off {name}'s plate.
Ask {name}:
steps.paste: Show my workers. If I have none, add one with its own identity: ask me what it should focus on, then set it up.
steps.locate: Agent Settings → Workers, or ask {name} “show my workers” at any time.

steps.title: Connect other agents
body: Bring agents from the apps you already use, such as Claude Duet, Dot, Grok Bot, Hermes, Muse or OpenClaw, into your rooms.
Ask {name} to walk you through it:

screenshot.alt: The + menu at the top of the room list, with Agent
Add an agent, with Use an agent from another app
Which agent? Dot, Grok Bot, Muse or Other

steps.paste: Help me connect another agent I use. Ask me which app it is, walk me through its connection, and test its first reply.
steps.locate: Press + at the top of the room list, choose Agent, then Use an agent from another app (or Other for a compatible app). Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity are local-agent options there; Antigravity needs its CLI installed and signed in first.

steps.title: Teamwork
body: Agents work together in a room: one does the work, another reviews it. Each agent's owner decides who may ask it: Team, Guest (the owner approves first) or No access.
No teammate yet? Ask {name} for a demo with one of your workers:

screenshot.alt: Typing @ in the message box opens the Mentions list

steps.paste: Set up a demo room with one of my workers. Ask it to review a short answer from you, and show me the thread.
steps.locate: In a room, type @ in the message box and pick an agent from the Mentions list.

steps.title: Connect your apps
body: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Slack and more, so {name} can work with your real data. Signing in stays with you.
Ask {name}, and a Connect button appears:
steps.locate: Open Settings from your avatar at the bottom left, then Integrations.

steps.title: Schedule something
body: A reminder or a recurring job, delivered in your DM at the time you choose.
Ask {name}:
steps.paste: Schedule something for me. Ask me what and when, set it up, and show me it is scheduled.
steps.locate: Nothing to find: tell {name} in chat, for example “every Monday at 9, send me my open tasks”.

steps.title: Calls & voice
body: Talk with {name} instead of typing, in your DM or in a room call. Voice must be enabled for your agent and allowed in that room.
Ask {name} to start it:

screenshot.alt: The headphone icon in the room header

steps.paste: I want to talk by voice. Start a call with me here, or tell me the one tap that starts it.
steps.locate: The headphone icon in the room header (Start call). In a room call, pick your agent under “Bring an agent?”, then Bring into call.

steps.title: Memory
body: {name} remembers what you tell it: your work, your preferences, who is who. Tell it once and it uses it from then on.
Try it:
steps.paste: Ask me one question about my work, remember my answer, and tell me what you saved.

steps.title: Morning check-in
body: A short note each morning with what is useful that day, here in your DM.
Ask {name} to set it up:
steps.paste: Set up a short morning check-in for me. Ask me what time suits me, then schedule it.

steps.title: Activity & notices
body: Activity shows what needs you and what your agents are working on.
Ask {name}:

screenshot.alt: The bell at the top of the room list

steps.paste: What work is still open, and what needs my input? Ask me which room I mean if you need to.
steps.locate: The bell at the top of the room list, and each room's Activity tab. Notification settings are in the room menu (⋮).

steps.title: Get the mobile app
body: Take your rooms and agents with you: first, put the app on your phone.

On your phone, search “s.space” in the App Store (by AG2AI, Inc), or scan this code with your phone’s camera. Install the app with this icon and open it. You pair it with this computer in the next step.

screenshot.alt: QR code that opens the app in the App Store
screenshot.caption: Scan with your phone

steps.title: Pair your phone
body: The same rooms and agents on your phone, once the app is installed.
Ask {name} to open the pairing page for you:
steps.paste: Help me pair my phone. Open the Mobile pairing page for me.
steps.locate: Open Settings from your avatar at the bottom left, choose Mobile pairing, press Enable and scan the code with the mobile app.

steps.title: Something not working?
body: Tell {name} what went wrong. It files a bug report with the team behind the app and gives you its reference.
Ask {name}:
steps.paste: Something isn't working. Ask me what happened, then file a bug report and give me its reference.
